task:
Implement `slugify(text, max_length=None)` in `src/textkit/slug.py`.
It currently raises NotImplementedError.

Rules:
- Normalize with unicodedata NFKD and drop combining marks, so "Café" becomes "cafe".
- Lowercase the result.
- Replace every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single "-".
- Strip leading and trailing "-".
- If max_length is given, truncate to at most max_length characters and then
  strip any trailing "-" again.
- Empty or whitespace-only input returns "".
